setupWizard.title: First-run wizard
setupWizard.description: The remaining steps of the installation in order. Each step opens its Settings page; a step's state is read from the configuration on the server.
setupWizard.settingsHint: The installation's steps in order: site settings, log sources, Kamu SM, replica and e-mail.
setupWizard.loadFailed: The configuration could not be read
setupWizard.nothingMissing: Nothing is missing in this step.

admin.title: Administrator and two-step verification
admin.purpose: The first administrator account is created at installation; two-step verification is set up at the first sign-in. As you opened this page, this step is done. Further accounts are added in the user management of Settings.

site.title: Site settings
site.purpose: The organisation name appears in reports, e-mails and evidence packages. The time servers keep the server's clock, and so the times of the records, right; a local time source is recommended.

sources.title: Log sources
sources.purpose: The devices that send logs (firewall, core router) are defined here as sources. Only the records of defined, enabled sources are expected; a source that falls silent raises an alert.

kamusm_test.title: Kamu SM: test server
kamusm_test.purpose: A time stamp from the test server shows that Java, the Zamane client, the root certificates and the customer credentials work together. The test is the stamp test step of Settings → Kamu SM.

kamusm_production.title: Kamu SM: production
kamusm_production.purpose: The daily seals take their time stamp from the Kamu SM production server. After the switch to production, sealing must be ready; if it is not, the causes are listed below.

replica.title: Replica
replica.purpose: Sealed days are copied to a second place, a network share. If the server's disk fails, the copies remain on the replica.

smtp.title: E-mail
smtp.purpose: Alerts and reports are sent by e-mail. This needs an SMTP server and a sender address.

summary.title: Summary
summary.purpose: The state of the steps and the problems of the configuration. Open a step that is missing to complete it.

missing.siteProblems: The organisation name or a time server is not set (see the problems below).
missing.noSource: No log source is defined yet.
missing.noEnabled: None of the defined sources is enabled.
missing.noTest: No stamp test succeeded and was verified.
missing.notProduction: Time stamps do not come from the Kamu SM production server.

sources.firewallManaged: ARCILOGGER's firewall rule opens port 514 to the addresses of the enabled sources by itself.
sources.firewallNotManaged: The firewall is not managed by ARCILOGGER; open port 514 to these addresses by hand (INSTALL.md section 12).
sources.deviceSetup: Device settings: DEVICE-SETUP.md sections 1 and 4 (verify the commands on site).
sources.arrivalUnknown: Data state could not be read

kamusm.legal: Stamps of the test server have no legal validity (Kamu SM); before switching to production compare the root fingerprints with the values Kamu SM publishes (verify on site).

summary.noProblems: No problem found in the configuration.
